subject: Malaysia M-510 TiO2 — technical review and a free 1 kg sample
body:
For Bailey's paint formulations, M-510 provides a chloride-process rutile option for evaluation. Its TDS lists typical values of 94.5% TiO2 and 17.5 g/100 g oil absorption, giving your technical team a starting point for comparison.

Our EU REACH documentation lists registration 01-2119489379-17-0278.

We can provide a free 1 kg sample to check performance in your own formulations.

Shall we arrange a sample for your technical team's evaluation?
